items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: But Monday through Friday Mr. Jesse played the guitar for us you know.

ctx.x: Very good question. I had started taking piano lessons when I was 11 years old. And the reason I started to take piano lessons, I loved music and I would hear music and on the — we called it record player or phonograph where you wind it up and didn’t have any electricity or anything, and you put those 78 records on and oh I’d listen to those all day and I was very careful not to break one because if you broke one you got your butt whooped because that was not — you know when you break one it’s no repair for those…

of his overalls, all muddy and everything, and get his guitar and start to sing and play the blues. And that was — oh we did it every day, a concert every day except the weekends. Because Saturday and Sunday was, you know, Saturday was the shopping day and everything, and Sunday was the going to church day. That was all laid out in our neighborhood. That’s what people did. But Monday through Friday Mr. Jesse played the guitar for us you know. And we were kids and we lived on the hill where the water would rise…
What would you buy with that nickel?
